$comment: DERIVED, NOT HAND-WRITTEN. Regenerate by reading tests/meta/guard-liveness.test.ts; this file is a SHRINK-ONLY RATCHET of guards that exist but do not run in the one required check (`Lint, TypeCheck, Unit Tests`). The spec asserts this set EXACTLY equals the derived set: adding a dark guard REDs, and fixing or deleting one REDs until the entry is removed. Entries leave this file by being wired into the required check or deleted — never by being edited to match a new reality.
